name: purgeRenderCaches
description: Ask the renderers and GPU process a Nexus client uses to drop their caches (decoded images, GPU transfer cache, font and Skia caches) by sending them a memory-pressure level. Nothing is terminated or frozen. Rate-limited per target in the host (10 s). Returns { purged: string[], throttled: string[], guestProcesses, agentTabProcesses, gpuProcesses }. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: Any of "guest" (the Nexus page's renderers in every window), "gpu" (the GPU process), "agentTabs" (renderers of session-tagged tabs). Default ["guest", "gpu"]. An unknown name is invalid_args.

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: "moderate" or "critical" (default). An unknown level is invalid_args.
